Class Manager

java.lang.Object
depot.system.core.Manager
public class Manager extends Object
Manages interactions between the customer queue, parcel map, and log. Provides functionality to read customers and parcels from CSV files and update the corresponding data structures. This class is the controller, operating the main functiosn of the system

    • readCustomers

      public static void readCustomers(String filePath)
      Reads customer data from a CSV file and adds valid customers to the queue. Invalid entries are logged and skipped. The CSV format is following the template given by the tutor with 2 columns: Customer name and Parcel ID.
      Parameters:
      filePath - the path to the CSV file containing customer data.

    • readParcels

      Parameters:
      filePath - the path to the CSV file containing parcel data.

    • addCustomer

      public void addCustomer(String name, String parcelID)
      Adds a new customer to the queue. Note: This method updates the in-memory queue or map only. Changes will not save to the original CSV files as I'm using the template provided and don't want to overwrite anything.
      Parameters:
      name - the name of the customer; must not be null or empty.
      parcelID - the parcel ID associated with the customer; must not be null or empty.

    • addParcel

      public void addParcel(String parcelID, String dimensions, double weight, int daysInDepot, String status)
      Adds a new parcel to the parcel map. Note: This method updates the in-memory queue or map only. Changes will not save to the original CSV files as I'm using the template provided and don't want to overwrite anything.
      Parameters:
      parcelID - the unique ID of the parcel; must not be null or empty.
      dimensions - the dimensions of the parcel in "length x width x height" format; must be valid.
      weight - the weight of the parcel in kilograms; must be non-negative.
      daysInDepot - the number of days the parcel has been in the depot; must be non-negative.
      status - the status of the parcel; must be "Waiting" or "Collected".
